root_cause.text: The `rawdata_get_link_base` function in `security/apparmor/apparmorfs.c` dereferences `profile->rawdata` without verifying it is non-null, causing a NULL pointer dereference when the pointer is cleared during profile replacement after `export_binary` is disabled.
root_cause.evidence: The patch inserts a null check `if (!profile->rawdata)` returning `-ENOENT` before accessing `profile->rawdata->name`, and the CVE description explicitly identifies the crash as occurring when trying to dereference `profile->rawdata->name` when `profile->rawdata` is NULL.

When export_binary is disabled and profile replacement occurs, profile->rawdata gets cleared to NULL, causing a NULL pointer dereference when this return statement executes.
